8d0015.conditions: none; NBX size exchange and the data exchange are correctly separated in every call
8d0015.reasoning: The sizes go through PstreamDetail::allToAllConsensus (Map), a proper NBX: MPI_Issend with tag msgType()+1867, MPI_Iprobe(ANY_SOURCE, that tag), then MPI_Recv from status.MPI_SOURCE, and MPI_Ibarrier only after MPI_Testall shows all synchronous sends matched. When the barrier completes, every Issend of the call has been matched by a receive, so nothing from call c can reach the probe in call c+1, even though the tag is the same. Because Issend is synchronous, buffering does not matter. The data phase uses tag msgType() with Irecv posted for specific sources (maxCommsSize=0, so no chunking), Isend, and waitall. A ring sends one message per pair per call, and non-overtaking plus call order keeps them matched. The two tags differ, so the probe cannot take a data message. The final reduce comes after all requests have completed. Matching order cannot change the outcome.
